title: Holiday harmonies: 6 theater stars come together for ‘Christmas 3’ concert
summary: Six powerhouse performers — Arman Ferrer, Shiela Valderrama, Gian Magdangal, Lara Maigue, Nyoy Volante and Mikkie Bradshaw-Volante — will take the stage for "Christmas 3."
